$comment: JSON structural mirror of references/shapes-core.ttl, in the shape-registry format scripts/validate_tool_call.py's generic evaluator (evaluate_shape / evaluate_property_shape) reads at runtime. Copy this file to <project-root>/.ontology-agent/schema/shapes.json (bootstrap.py does this automatically). Per the 'Named Limitation' section of references/validation-protocol.md, this file does NOT auto-sync with shapes-core.ttl -- if shapes-core.ttl gains a shape, tightens a constraint, or renames a property, this file (and the copy already deployed under a project's .ontology-agent/schema/) must be updated by hand to match.

properties.$comment: Restated from EntityShape rather than inherited: this evaluator does not compose supertype shapes automatically (each tool's x-shape-target selects exactly one shape), so TaskShape must be self-contained -- see validation-protocol.md's 'third simplification'.

DecisionShape.$comment: shapes-core.ttl also declares sh:or([:dependsOn minCount 1] [:constrains minCount 1]) on DecisionShape. This evaluator has no sh:or/sh:xone support (see the supported-constraint table in validation-protocol.md), so that disjunctive 'needs at least one real edge' rule is NOT enforced here -- a real, documented gap, not an oversight. No tool currently declares x-shape-target: Decision, so this is currently unreachable from validate_tool_call.py's CLI path.
